prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car‑accident case — the right lawyer depends on your facts (injuries, disputed liability, amount of damages), your goals (fast settlement vs. trial), and your preferences (firm size, communication style, budget). I can help you find the best lawyer for your situation. To start:

Quick next steps right now
- Seek medical care and preserve records and photos of the crash, injuries, vehicle damage, and scene.
- Do not give recorded statements to insurers without an attorney.
- Preserve phone/video evidence and witness contact info.

How to pick the best Atlanta car‑accident lawyer for you
1. Look for relevant experience
   - Focus on attorneys who handle car-accident personal injury cases regularly and have trial experience if fault or damages are contested.
2. Results and references
   - Ask about past settlements/verdicts in similar cases and request client references or read recent reviews.
3. Communication and availability
   - Confirm who will handle the file day-to-day and how you’ll receive updates.
4. Fee structure
   - Most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Ask the contingency percentage and who pays expenses if you lose.
5. Credentials and reputation
   - Check peer ratings (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell), client reviews (Google/Yelp/AVVO), and disciplinary history with the State Bar of Georgia.
6. Local knowledge
   - A lawyer familiar with Atlanta courts, judges, and local medical/legal providers can be helpful.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- Who will work on my case and how often will I hear from them?
- What is your contingency fee and how are costs handled?
- Do you have trial experience? When was your last trial verdict?
- How long will this likely take and what’s a realistic settlement range?

Where to search local attorneys
- Super Lawyers (Georgia list), Martindale‑Hubbell, AVVO, Google/Yelp reviews, and referrals from friends/family.
- Verify standing with the State Bar of Georgia (online).

If you want, I can:
- Suggest 3–5 Atlanta attorneys or firms known for car-accident work (I’ll note I can’t browse in real time, but can offer a list of well-known names commonly recommended).
- Help you draft an email or list of questions to send to attorneys.
- Help evaluate offers or settlements if you share details.

Tell me more about your case (date of crash, injuries, whether fault/insurance is disputed, any offers received, and whether you want a big firm or a smaller boutique) and I’ll tailor recommendations.
